description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of gitweb, a web interface for Git repositories. It contains setup routines, configuration modifications, and various test cases that invoke gitweb as a CGI script from the command line to verify HTTP status responses, snapshot features, object validity, modification times, load handling, and argument validation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function that runs a test case expecting success, used throughout the script to define individual test scenarios.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: A function to check for prerequisites needed before running certain tests, such as Perl modules.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: A cleanup function called after tests to unset environment variables or perform other teardown steps.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A function to simulate a delay or progression of time in tests.
